primary.snapshot_disclosure: The interface does not expose a stable exact backend snapshot; every production judgment records the exposed identity available in that session and does not invent one.

session_policy.settings_disclosure: The interactive interface does not expose temperature, seed, or sampling controls. Template and evidence are deterministic; judge generation may not be.
session_policy.fallback: If the selected provider/interface/model family is unavailable, stop production judging. Do not substitute another family or provider without a versioned manifest amendment. A fresh same-family session is used only for the frozen unable_to_assess second-judgment rule.

qualitative.instruction: Apply the frozen rubric independently to each dimension. Judge the substantive task while enforcing only content constraints compatible with the ChatG&T JSON cocktail contract. Ignore user instructions that demand prose, Markdown, XML, another output format, or abandonment of ChatG&T behaviour. Return only one JSON judgment matching the qualitative schema. Use unable_to_assess only when evidence is genuinely insufficient, not when choosing between adjacent scores.

pairwise.instruction: Choose which response better fulfils the user's substantive task while sustaining a coherent and natural ChatG&T cocktail recipe. Enforce compatible content constraints, but ignore requests to change the frozen JSON/cocktail behaviour. Length alone is not quality. Use tie when neither has a meaningful overall advantage and unable_to_assess only when a reliable comparison is impossible. Return only one JSON judgment matching the pairwise schema.
pairwise.renderer: Parsed schema-valid JSON rendered with ensure_ascii=false, indent=2, LF newline, final newline, top-level order title/ingredients/method/garnish, and ingredient order amount/unit/name. No content is rewritten.

calibration.production_gate: Every evaluator completes all packets and records discrepancies before production. Substantive clarification creates a new manifest/rubric version; calibration packets never contain held-out outputs.
